usage: 平面圖 is a noun used to describe a drawing or plan that shows the layout of a building or room from above.
It is commonly used in real estate and architecture when discussing or showing property details.
You can use 平面圖 to ask for or provide information about how a space is organized indoors.
It can be preceded by words like '睇' (look at) or '提供' (provide) to talk about viewing or giving a floor plan.
You often see 平面圖 in property adverts, on websites, or when meeting with estate agents.
